Definition: {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now}
BiblicalUsage: Kah means 'like this' — 'thus,' 'so,' 'in this manner.' Daniel closes his vision with it: hitherto is the end of the matter, thus far and no further.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a word like 'thus' has its place: God's revelations end where He ends them, and I am not meant to add a word beyond.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
